# Dependency licence notices

Some published crate archives omit their licence files. `notices.json` records
replacement notices copied from each archive's `.cargo_vcs_info.json` revision,
with source URLs and SHA-256 hashes. Packaging matches the exact crate name,
version and source, and verifies these declared files before including them.

The standalone Peios SDK and authd notices cover the pinned Git dependencies,
whose crate directories inherit their repository licence.
